title: Kissinger in Army counterintelligence tech retrieval
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kissinger in Army counterintelligence tech retrieval, about 1940s at Europe, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Kissinger was an army counterintel guy who was doing tech retrieval at the time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1940s in Europe the American statesman Henry Kissinger was an Army counterintelligence officer doing what Michels calls tech retrieval, meaning collecting technology. He tells it to suggest Kissinger had early experience recovering advanced hardware, the kind of background that would fit a later role with crashed UFOs.
